[RHIM.6.2] An assert carrying an explicit TTL must override the asserted fact's deadline
with the supplied TTL for that single assertion, including on a `logical` schema.
The engine's TTL sweep retracts the fact when the clock passes
`assert_time + retain_ns`. Hydration imposes no `logical` semantics on hydrated
facts ([LHYD.6.5]): their lifetime is the `retain:` expiry, a superseding
correlation (RHIM.5.2), or explicit retraction.
